      "path": "models.py",
      "content": "from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Date, DateTime, Text, ForeignKey, CheckConstraint, UniqueConstraint\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import relationship\nfrom database import Base\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    microchip_id = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"status IN ('Available', 'Medical Treatment', 'Foster Care', 'Adopted', 'Euthanized', 'Transferred')\")\n    temperament = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass AnimalNote(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animal_notes\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    note = Column(Text, nullable=False)\n    created_by = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    animal = relationship(\"Animal\")\n    author = relationship(\"User\")\n\n\nclass FosterParent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"foster_parents\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"), unique=True)\n    full_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    address = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationship\n    user = relationship(\"User\")\n\n\nclass FosterPlacement(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"foster_placements\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    foster_parent_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"foster_parents.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    start_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    end_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Active\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('Active', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    animal = relationship(\"Animal\")\n    foster_parent = relationship(\"FosterParent\")\n\n\nclass FosterSupplyRequest(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"foster_supply_requests\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    foster_placement_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"foster_placements.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"Pending\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('Pending', 'Approved', 'Fulfilled', 'Cancelled')\")\n    notes = Column(Text)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationship\n    foster_placement = relationship(\"FosterPlacement\")\n\n\nclass FosterSupplyItem(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"foster_supply_items\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    supply_request_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"foster_supply_requests.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    item_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)\n    unit = Column(String)\n    notes = Column(Text)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationship\n    supply_request = relationship(\"FosterSupplyRequest\")"

      "path": "schemas.py",
      "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel, Field\nfrom typing import List, Optional\nfrom datetime import date\n\n\nclass AnimalOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    microchip_id: str\n    name: str\n    status: str\n    temperament: str\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\nclass FosterPlacementOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    animal_id: int\n    foster_parent_id: int\n    start_date: date\n    status: str\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\nclass FosterSupplyRequestOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    foster_placement_id: int\n    status: str\n    notes: Optional[str] = None\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }\n\nclass SupplyItemIn(BaseModel):\n    item_name: str\n    quantity: int\n    unit: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass FosterPlacementUpdateIn(BaseModel):\n    temperament: str = Field(..., description=\"New temperament value for the animal\")\n    note: str = Field(..., description=\"Note to append to animal's notes\")\n    foster_parent_username: str = Field(..., description=\"Username of the foster parent to assign\")\n    start_date: date = Field(..., description=\"Start date for the foster placement\")\n    supply_items: List[SupplyItemIn] = Field(..., description=\"List of supply items to request for the foster placement\")\n\n\nclass FosterPlacementUpdateResponse(BaseModel):\n    animal: AnimalOut\n    foster_placement: FosterPlacementOut\n    supply_request: FosterSupplyRequestOut\n\n    model_config = {\n        \"from_attributes\": True\n    }"
    },
    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Depends\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom typing import List\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Animal, AnimalNote, FosterParent, FosterPlacement, FosterSupplyRequest, FosterSupplyItem\nfrom schemas import FosterPlacementUpdateIn, FosterPlacementUpdateResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"AnimalFosterPlacement\"])\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/animals/{microchip_id}/foster-placement\",\n    operation_id=\"update_animal_foster_placement\",\n    response_model=FosterPlacementUpdateResponse\n)\nasync def update_animal_foster_placement(\n    microchip_id: str,\n    payload: FosterPlacementUpdateIn,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Find the animal by microchip_id\n    animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.microchip_id == microchip_id).first()\n    if not animal:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Animal not found\")\n\n    # Verify animal is in 'Medical Treatment' status\n    if animal.status != \"Medical Treatment\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Animal is not in 'Medical Treatment' status\")\n\n    # Find foster parent by username\n    foster_parent = db.query(FosterParent).join(User).filter(User.username == payload.foster_parent_username).first()\n    if not foster_parent:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Foster parent not found\")\n\n    try:\n        # Update animal status and temperament\n        animal.status = \"Foster Care\"\n        animal.temperament = payload.temperament\n\n        # Add note to animal\n        new_note = AnimalNote(\n            animal_id=animal.id,\n            note=payload.note,\n            created_by=1  # Assuming Dr. Patel's user ID is 1\n        )\n        db.add(new_note)\n\n        # Create foster placement\n        foster_placement = FosterPlacement(\n            animal_id=animal.id,\n            foster_parent_id=foster_parent.id,\n            start_date=payload.start_date,\n            status=\"Active\"\n        )\n        db.add(foster_placement)\n        db.flush()  # Ensure placement has an ID before creating supply request\n\n        # Create foster supply request\n        supply_request = FosterSupplyRequest(\n            foster_placement_id=foster_placement.id,\n            status=\"Pending\"\n        )\n        db.add(supply_request)\n        db.flush()  # Ensure supply request has an ID before adding items\n\n        # Add supply items\n        for item_data in payload.supply_items:\n            supply_item = FosterSupplyItem(\n                supply_request_id=supply_request.id,\n                item_name=item_data.item_name,\n                quantity=item_data.quantity,\n                unit=item_data.unit\n            )\n            db.add(supply_item)\n\n        db.commit()\n\n        # Refresh objects to get updated data\n        db.refresh(animal)\n        db.refresh(foster_placement)\n        db.refresh(supply_request)\n\n        return FosterPlacementUpdateResponse(\n            animal=animal,\n            foster_placement=foster_placement,\n            supply_request=supply_request\n        )\n\n    except IntegrityError as e:\n        db.rollback()\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Data integrity error occurred\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        db.rollback()\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=\"Internal server error\")"
    }
